honing_confound: Gravity Release skill damage and crit values scale with honing tier. Tier standing in current T4 meta reflects both skill-damage ceiling and Identity activation frequency. Crit Rate and Crit Damage bonuses from engraving (3/6/9% and 6/12/18% per core) compound with gear crit stats — gear-dependent multiplier.
pull_carrier_notes: Rage Hammer identity uses Gravity Release skills as primary output. Gravity Compression (core spender) creates a placed black hole mechanic (pull-to-point at black hole location, 9 hits). Gravity Impact (builder) pulls enemies to caster in 8-hit sequence. Pull is a RIDER in Rage Hammer — damage is primary, pull is density mechanic for multi-hit delivery. See pull tranche rows: la-destroyer-gravity-compression and la-destroyer-gravity-impact.
pull_carrier_delta_vs_pull_tranche: Pull tranche covered skill-grain rows (individual skill mechanics). This row covers ENGRAVING-GRAIN identity. Delta: Rage Hammer identity amplifies Gravity Release skills — specifically the crit scaling on core expenditure. Gravity Compression (the pull-to-point skill) is a Gravity Release skill and therefore DIRECTLY amplified by Rage Hammer. So Rage Hammer identity = the pull-enabling identity (amplifies the pull-containing skill). Pull is mechanically present as a density mechanic within the Rage Hammer kit's primary skill loop.

delivery.evidence: All Destroyer skills are melee. Perfect Swing, Seismic Hammer, Full Swing, Earth Eater are melee hammer attacks. Gravity Compression (Gravity Release) places black hole at target location up to 10m. Gravity Force releases gravitational energy in a line. Vortex Gravity (used in Gravity Training identity — available in Rage Hammer as non-identity skill) fires at caster position.

footprint.evidence: Melee hammer swings hit in frontal arcs or radii of 3-8m. Gravity Compression explosion radius: 5-6m at black hole location. No truly large-zone coverage.

geo_text: Gravity Release-focused Destroyer. Rage Hammer amplifies the crit output of purple core-spending skills. Spatial identity: close-range hammer attacks for Gravity Core generation (blue skills), then Gravity Release (purple) at or near caster/target position. Gravity Compression places black hole up to 10m away — the only true ranged delivery, but still landing at melee-adjacent range in practice.

control.evidence: Gravity Compression (Highest Stagger rating) and Perfect Swing have Stagger contributions. Gravity Impact delivers 8× pulls-to-self with stagger hits. In Rage Hammer, stagger is a rider — the identity amplifies crit, not CC. Stagger feeds LA boss phase-break mechanic.

defense.evidence: Hypergravity activation (Identity activation): Shield = 60% max HP + 30% damage reduction + CC immunity. This is the Destroyer's primary defense layer during its power window. Outside Hypergravity: heavy armor (Destroyer is melee warrior with high HP pool by design).

economy.resource_verbatim: Gravity Core system + Hypergravity Gauge (Identity Meter)
economy.builder_source: Blue (Concentration) skills generate Gravity Cores: Gravity Impact (+2 cores), Gravity Force (+2 cores). Can hold max 3 cores. Core spending via Gravity Release (purple) fills Hypergravity Gauge. Gravity Compression and Earth Eater are primary Gauge fillers.
economy.plain_text: THREE-LAYER ECONOMY: (1) Gravity Cores: blue skill builders generate 2 cores each; max 3 cores held. (2) Gravity Release: purple skills spend cores for amplified damage + fill Hypergravity Gauge. (3) Hypergravity (Z key): when Gauge fills, activate for 60% HP shield + 30% dmg reduction + CC immunity. In Rage Hammer: Crit Rate and Crit Damage scale with cores spent when using Gravity Release. The economy centers on cycling through this 3-layer loop as efficiently as possible.

element.evidence: Destroyer skills deal Physical damage. Gravity-typed effects (gravitational energy) are the thematic framing but map to Physical damage type in LA's damage system. Gravity Compression has a distinct 'gravitational explosion' that may have separate damage typing — not confirmed from live source.

movement.evidence: Maxroll guide explicitly notes 'lack of mobility, slow charge times, and front-attacking playstyle' as the core weakness. All major skills root the caster during animations. Animation cancel via spacebar is the only mobility tool.

attr.evidence: Melee-only. Front-attack orientation (most skills require frontal positioning).

range.evidence: Gravity Compression (Move Position tripod) places black hole up to 10m. Standard melee attacks 0-5m. Gravity Force sends gravitational energy in a ~6m line.

tempo.evidence: Rage Hammer is the sustained Destroyer identity: consistent core-generation and Gravity Release cycle rather than relying on a single burst window. Compared to Gravity Training (which gates into a burst-heavy Hypergravity Mode), Rage Hammer provides steadier output.

amp.value: Crit Rate +9-15% / Crit Damage +18-54% on Gravity Release skills when spending 3 cores (Rage Hammer at max level)
amp.evidence: Confirmed from Lost Ark Codex entry and search results: 1 core = +5% crit / +18% crit dmg; 2 cores = +10%/+32%; 3 cores = +15%/+54%.

proxy.evidence: No proxy mechanics. All output is direct. Gravity fields are visual effects of direct skills, not proxy entities.

commitment.evidence: Gravity Impact and Gravity Compression are channel-type skills (hold to release; 8-hit sequence and 2s charge respectively). Gravity Force is wind-up (7-hit attack sequence). Blue skills are faster wind-ups.

stabilization_patch: Rage Hammer was the dominant Destroyer identity from 2022-2024 due to Barricade synergy (shields from Gravity Release provide Barricade damage buff). Post-Ark-Passive (Feb 2025): identity mechanics preserved.
tier_standing_release: B-tier at launch; improved to A-tier by 2023 with Barricade synergy discovery
tier_standing_current: B-tier (Maxroll community tier list 2025-2026). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: tier reflects mobility penalty (slowest class in game) in modern raid designs that require movement. Raw damage output is competitive; practical tier is mobility-penalized.

The +30% Crit Rate and +20% Damage on Identity Skill are percentage bonuses applied at whatever base damage level honing provides.
pull_carrier_notes: Gravity Training CENTERS on Hypergravity Mode (Z key). In Hypergravity Mode: only basic attacks and Vortex Gravity are available. Vortex Gravity = 6m pull radius + hammer slam + gravitational explosion. Pull is CORE to this identity — the primary burst skill in Hypergravity is the pull skill. Strongest pull-carrier in LA at engraving-path grain.

delivery.evidence: Gravity Training uses the same blue/purple skill set for gauge-filling. Vortex Gravity (the Hypergravity identity skill) hits at caster position with 6m radial pull.

footprint.evidence: Vortex Gravity: 6m pull radius centered on caster = the largest footprint in the Gravity Training kit. Blue skill footprints are same as Rage Hammer. Hypergravity Mode burst is melee-range radial.

geo_text: Gravity Training Destroyer cycles through blue skill generation → Gravity Release gauge-filling → Hypergravity Mode activation. Inside Hypergravity: the world is reduced to left-click spam + Vortex Gravity (pull + damage at 6m radius). Outside Hypergravity: same melee positional identity as Rage Hammer but skill selection tilted toward fast gauge filling rather than maximum Gravity Release crit output.

control.evidence: Vortex Gravity (the primary Hypergravity skill) = 6m pull radius + stagger=High + armor debuff. Pull IS the delivery mechanism for the burst skill in this identity. Gravity Training is the pull-carrier identity at engraving-path grain.

defense.evidence: Same as Rage Hammer: Hypergravity activation = 60% max HP shield + 30% damage reduction + CC immunity. Gravity Training emphasizes entering Hypergravity more frequently (identity-focused) → more frequent access to the defensive window.

economy.resource_verbatim: Gravity Core system + Hypergravity Gauge + passive +2% per second Identity Gauge generation
economy.builder_source: Same as Rage Hammer (blue skills generate Gravity Cores; Gravity Release fills Hypergravity Gauge). GRAVITY TRAINING BONUS: passive +2% per second Identity Gauge generation — this is the key distinguishing mechanic vs Rage Hammer, making Hypergravity Mode activatable more frequently without relying solely on Gravity Release spending.
economy.plain_text: THREE-LAYER ECONOMY (same as Rage Hammer) PLUS passive gauge tick. Gravity Training adds +2% per second automatic Hypergravity Gauge fill — meaning even without using Gravity Release skills, the Hypergravity window approaches. Identity Skill (Hypergravity) gets +30% Crit Rate + 20% Damage. The identity is HYPERGRAVITY-CENTRIC: maximize activations, maximize Vortex Gravity damage inside each window.

movement.evidence: Same poor mobility. Hypergravity Mode: movement is restricted (can walk but rooted during VG cast). Basic attack (left-click spam) is the only mobile action inside Hypergravity.

attr.evidence: Same melee positioning. Vortex Gravity requires being at caster position (self-centered).

range.evidence: Hypergravity primary skill (Vortex Gravity) has 6m pull radius from caster. Outside Hypergravity: same as Rage Hammer.

tempo.evidence: Gravity Training is the BURST identity: outside Hypergravity = buildup phase; inside Hypergravity = burst window where only VG+basic attack matters. Burst cadence driven by passive gauge tick + Gravity Release spending.

amp.value: Identity Skill +30% Crit Rate +20% Damage; passive +2% per second Identity Gauge generation
amp.evidence: Confirmed from search results: 'Identity Skill getting +30% Crit Rate and +20% Damage. This build revolves around generating a large amount of meter.'

commitment.evidence: Same channel-type blue/purple skills. Vortex Gravity in Hypergravity Mode is instant (fires on identity activation per pull tranche row la-destroyer-vortex-gravity: 'fires on Hypergravity Mode activation — instant'). Basic attack spam in Hypergravity is continuous.

mechanics_notes: 1) Gravity Training is the identity where PULL IS THE PRIMARY BURST MECHANIC. In Hypergravity Mode, Vortex Gravity is the only available damage skill — the caster's entire burst phase output runs through the pull skill. This is unique in the corpus: no other class has a pull skill as the exclusive active in its burst window. 2) DESTROYER CROSS-REFERENCE: This identity was sourced for pull tranche at skill grain. This row confirms: Gravity Training selects INTO the pull mechanic at identity level. The identity name itself literally refers to training the gravitational energy — the gravity/pull theme is the design intent. 3) Hypergravity Mode grants full CC/debuff immunity to the caster + area slow on enemies in range (compounding with VG's 6m pull). During the burst window, the Destroyer is immune to CC while pulling enemies into point-blank range and delivering stagger+armor debuff. 4) PHASE CONTRAST: Gravity Training has a much more distinct phase rhythm than Rage Hammer — the buildup phase (neutral Destroyer) vs. burst phase (Hypergravity Destroyer) feel like different characters. Rage Hammer is more uniform. This phase contrast is important for game-feel analysis.
stabilization_patch: Gravity Training was a secondary identity at launch; gained community interest 2022-2023 when players valued the Hypergravity burst window for specific raid mechanics. Rage Hammer remained more popular overall.
